def check_circulant(n, S):
    """Check if circulant graph with connection set S has no K_5 in G or complement"""
    # Build adjacency
    adj = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            diff = (j - i) % n
            if diff in S or (n - diff) in S:
                adj[i][j] = adj[j][i] = True
    
    # Check all 5-sets
    for clique in itertools.combinations(range(n), 5):
        # Check if all edges are present (red clique)
        all_red = True
        all_blue = True
        for i, u in enumerate(clique):
            for v in clique[i+1:]:

                else:
                    all_red = False
                if not all_red and not all_blue:
                    break
            if not all_red and not all_blue:

    return True
